summary: Builds the RTC WebRTC configuration from server config, applying packet buffer defaults and publisher/subscriber media direction defaults.
summary_step: 1. Copies the RTC config section from the server config.
2. Builds the base rtcconfig.WebRTCConfig using the RTCConfig section and development mode flag.
3. Returns the base configuration error if construction fails.
4. Disables active TCP in the WebRTC setting engine because clients should initiate TCP dialing.
5. Applies default packet buffer sizes, falling back to 500 and then deriving video and audio sizes from the generic packet buffer size when unset.
6. Returns a WebRTCConfig with receiver packet buffer sizes, default non-consolidated publisher settings, and subscriber settings selected from send-side bandwidth estimation configuration.

summary: Rebuilds publisher media direction settings for consolidated or non-consolidated transport behavior.
Rebuilds subscriber media direction settings from congestion control flags that enable send-side bandwidth estimation.
Installs a packet buffer factory and wires its GetOrNew method into the WebRTC setting engine.
Builds publisher RTP header extension and RTCP feedback settings, including additional feedback and absolute-send-time support when consolidated mode is enabled.
summary_step: 1. If consolidated mode is enabled, returns publisher settings with audio MID, RID, audio level, and absolute capture time extensions.
2. In consolidated mode, enables video MID, RID, transport-cc, absolute-send-time, frame marking, dependency descriptor, repaired RTP stream ID, and absolute capture time extensions.
3. In consolidated mode, enables audio NACK and video transport-cc, REMB, FIR, NACK, and PLI feedback.
4. If consolidated mode is disabled, returns publisher settings with the same audio extensions and feedback.
5. In non-consolidated mode, enables video MID, RID, transport-cc, frame marking, dependency descriptor, repaired RTP stream ID, and absolute capture time extensions.
6. In non-consolidated mode, enables video transport-cc, FIR, NACK, and PLI feedback without REMB or absolute-send-time.

summary: Builds subscriber RTP header extension and RTCP feedback settings, selecting transport-wide congestion control or absolute-send-time and REMB based on congestion control mode.
summary_step: 1. Creates base subscriber settings with video dependency descriptor and absolute capture time extensions, audio absolute capture time extension, audio NACK feedback, and video FIR, NACK, and PLI feedback.
2. If TWCC is enabled, appends the transport-cc RTP header extension and transport-cc RTCP feedback to video settings.
3. If TWCC is disabled, appends the absolute-send-time RTP header extension and REMB RTCP feedback to video settings.
4. Returns the completed subscriber direction configuration.
